unexpressed.text: DO NOT TRADE on this system. Included for completeness only.

unexpressed.text: If ever used: both shorts are deep ITM from the moment of entry, so the assignment guard fires immediately - which is why the OTM-equivalent iron condor is always the correct expression

safety_gaps.why: the structure has 2 short leg(s) and no compiled assignment guard. These are AMERICAN options on shares: a short that finishes in the money delivers 100 shares per contract the account never sized for.
a short call plus a dividend rule in the document, and no compiled guard. A short call with less extrinsic than the dividend is exercised the night before the ex-date.
